newsitem.title: CHINA: Chairmen mull selling Ocean-Land stake.
newsitem.headline: Chairmen mull selling Ocean-Land stake.

text.p: Ocean-Land Development Ltd said on Thursday a third party had expressed interest in buying a stake in the company from chairman Chou Wen Hsien and vice chairman Chow Chung Kai.
"They have been approached by an independent third party which has expressed interest to acquire shares in the company from them," Ocean-Land said in a statement.
"The acquisition, if successful, may lead to a general offer being made to all shareholders of the company."
Chou and Chow own 38.13 million shares between them, or 47.85 percent of the company's share capital.
Ocean-Land -- an investment holding company with subsidiaries engaged in shipping, property and investment -- said the negotiations with the third party were still at a preliminary stage.
The company's shares were up HK$3.30 or 28.2 percent to HK$15.00 at midday after hitting an all-time high of HK$15.80.
